rationale: No existing spec exercises print mode, the print button, or the SVG viewBox. The closest matches (dashboard-metric-camelcase.spec.js for metric/SVG panels, dashboardtype.spec.js for canvas panels) only assert that a chart renders with data and never touch print. The feature is a self-contained behavior (print-mode SVG scaling) with its own spec_path and playwright_group (Dashboards-Charts) already assigned in run-context, so a brand-new spec is the correct, non-duplicative action. It must be registered into ci_matrix.json under Dashboards-Charts.
